title: Power Stack Portfolio Management Overlay
purpose: Position-sizing, concentration, add/trim/recycle and risk-budget overlay. This does not change company company-evidence components.

dataQuality.currentWeights: Not calculated across the whole portfolio because holdings span MYR/USD and the YTL-linked warrant lacks a reliable standalone value. Avoid false precision until all positions and cash balances are normalized into one base currency.
dataQuality.scorePolicy: Company-evidence components remain in holdings-fundamentals.json. Macro/theme research only changes sizing, action gates and research priority unless company-specific evidence changes.
dataQuality.liveDeskPolicy: Live Desk canonical reasoning is a cross-check and research-priority input. It may tighten or loosen Power Stack action gates, but it does not overwrite company company-evidence components or automatically rerank a stock.
dataQuality.rateResiliencePolicy: The 10Y overlay may rerank research priority and tighten/loosen entry gates using already-verified company evidence. It does not mechanically change company-evidence components.

regime.structural: Expensive money + customer-backed AI infrastructure + product/logistics energy risk
regime.tactical: US equities can keep pushing on AI/earnings while broad credit stays relatively calm, but weak borrowers are already feeling punitive refinancing. Energy risk has shifted from missing crude toward products, logistics and infrastructure.
regime.portfolioRead: Do not de-risk indiscriminately and do not treat record indices as proof that rates no longer matter. Prefer contracted, cash-generative or strong-sponsor assets; keep dry powder for any broadening in HY/IG, MOVE/VIX or breadth weakness.

portfolioRules.rule: No automatic add to an already large single-name exposure. Treat 20-25% of investable portfolio value as a review zone, not an automatic sell trigger.
portfolioRules.reason: The current portfolio already has visible concentration in YTLPOWR and linked exposure; new capital should not compound the same risk without a materially better asymmetry.

portfolioRules.rule: Treat Malaysia power/data-centre exposure and energy/oil/shipping exposure as theme clusters, not independent positions. Review when one cluster approaches roughly one-third of portfolio risk.
portfolioRules.reason: Different tickers can still fail together when the same macro driver reverses.

portfolioRules.rule: No averaging down in positions whose technical or operating invalidation is active.
portfolioRules.reason: A lower price is not a new thesis. DAYANG, HIBISCS, TSLA and TTWO need repair/operating confirmation before fresh capital.

portfolioRules.rule: For fresh Power Stack additions, ask whether current earnings, FCF or contracted backlog can beat a 5%+ risk-free hurdle without relying on multiple expansion or cheaper refinancing.
portfolioRules.reason: Long real and nominal yields remain historically restrictive even though equities are resilient. The hurdle stays high, but strong sponsor-backed projects are proving that good assets can still finance.

portfolioRules.rule: For AI/power additions, require named customers, contracted demand, sponsor quality, financing visibility, cost recovery and cash conversion. Penalise projects that need cheap refinancing or weak guarantees.
portfolioRules.reason: The market is two-speed: weak borrowers face punitive costs while Google/Constellation-style contracted infrastructure and strongly sponsored AI financing can still clear at scale.

portfolioRules.rule: Keep a deployable reserve rather than forcing full investment while bank/credit/breadth confirmation is incomplete.
portfolioRules.reason: Broad HY/IG stress is not yet confirmed, but long yields remain restrictive and the weak-credit tail is already worsening. Dry powder preserves optionality if stress broadens.

portfolioRules.rule: When adding a new correlated theme exposure, first ask what existing lower-quality exposure it replaces.
portfolioRules.reason: Portfolio improvement should come from capital recycling, not only gross exposure growth.

actions.role: largest structural growth / Malaysia power concentration
actions.sizingRead: Concentration is the primary portfolio-management constraint even though the structural thesis remains strong.
actions.addGate: Only reconsider after portfolio weight is normalized, price clears ~RM6.02/~RM6.14 and contracted load, funding, grid/self-supply, permitting and FCF conversion improve.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Consider partial risk reduction only if concentration exceeds the chosen cap, financing/contracted-load evidence weakens, or a confirmed breakout fails materially; do not trim solely because the position is profitable.

actions.sizingRead: Treat as part of YTLPOWR concentration, not as diversification.
actions.addGate: None until strike, expiry, liquidity and standalone market value are verified.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Time decay/liquidity or parent-thesis deterioration can justify recycling before the parent equity.

actions.sizingRead: Keep as the highest-quality energy anchor; do not add merely because refined-product stress persists.
actions.addGate: Controlled retest plus product/crack confirmation and stable company operations.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Reduce only if energy cluster concentration is excessive or integrated/refining economics deteriorate; crude de-escalation alone is not enough.

actions.sizingRead: Lower WTI reduces macro support; this should not receive fresh capital before repair.
actions.addGate: Repair RM2.20-2.25 plus stable realized pricing/production.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Failure to repair with weakening operations makes it a candidate source of capital for higher-quality or less-correlated exposure.

actions.sizingRead: Useful diversification inside energy, but still tied to route/freight conditions and Yinson funding risk.
actions.addGate: Yinson structure/funding clarity plus resilient freight/tanker economics.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Route normalization plus weaker freight or adverse funding terms reduce the case.

actions.sizingRead: Do not use lower long yields as a substitute for GTA VI execution/cash-flow proof.
actions.addGate: Sustained ~$210 then $216-217 reclaim plus catalyst execution.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Further technical deterioration or catalyst/cash-flow slippage.

actions.sizingRead: Tactical rate relief helps, but valuation and execution remain the dominant risk-budget constraints.
actions.addGate: Sustained >$383 then ~$397 plus stronger storage/autonomy cash-flow evidence.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Failure of repair, worsening auto economics or evidence that optionality is not converting into cash flow.

actions.sizingRead: Highest-priority capital-recycling candidate if operating proof does not improve.
actions.trimOrRecycleGate: Break of RM1.42 or continued weak utilization/work-order conversion.

newCapitalPriority.instruction: GRAB moves to active buy research because the core marketplace turnaround is increasingly proven. Do not add until Atome and the expanding lending book pass a credit-quality/FCF underwrite.

newCapitalPriority.bucket: Nuclear cash flow and contracted power
newCapitalPriority.instruction: BWXT enters the scored Research Now list alongside CEG. BWXT offers defence/commercial nuclear cash flow without merchant-power concentration; CEG remains stronger contracted-power proof but should not be chased after the deal gap.

Retire the old CTVA seed thesis. VYLR now owns seed/genetics and needs fresh underwriting; CF has the strongest current cash evidence; NTR is secondary; BG stays lower-priority but is not a stop-looking name.

Alibaba remains the lead platform research name. Pair it with CGN/China Resources Power for cash-generating electricity exposure and use 3191/CXMT/Montage as distinct semiconductor-sovereignty implementations, not interchangeable tickers.
MU and CRDO remain high-quality research, but they add to an already heavy AI/power factor. Fresh capital requires a clearly better price/asymmetry than the diversifying opportunities above.

liveDeskCrossCheck.alignment: Live still shows higher real/nominal yields with strong AI/semiconductor breadth and relatively calm broad credit. MacroPulse adds an important refinement: weak-credit stress is already visible, while strong sponsor-backed AI and customer-backed power projects remain financeable.
portfolioImplications: Expensive money still rewards current cash flow and funded/contracted growth; this supports BWXT/CEG/CF more than speculative project finance.
Calm broad credit means do not de-risk indiscriminately, but weak borrowers and future-heavy stories still need a higher proof hurdle.
GRAB and agriculture offer better factor diversification than adding more AI/power beta, but GRAB's credit expansion and agriculture's farm economics must be underwritten directly.
China weak domestic credit argues for selective cash-generating power and AI/cloud businesses with real revenue rather than indiscriminate China beta.
TTWO now has a dated near-term catalyst; the stock's weak tape should be researched, not used as a reason to stop looking.

stockRadar.powerStackRead: Leadership and concentration barometer. Strong AI breadth supports the theme, but price/valuation and flow mechanics remain separate PS questions.
Cleaner read on semiconductor leadership and breadth than one stock. Use it to test whether the AI rally remains broad inside the complex.

liveDeskCrossCheck.scoreDecision: No current-holding company-evidence component changes. CEG is promoted on independently verified company-level contracted-power evidence; other macro and transcript changes alter research priority and action gates, not holding scores.

rateResilienceOverlay.admissionQuestion: Can this company beat a 5.2% risk-free hurdle without multiple expansion?

regimeRules.relief: 10Y <5% + breadth improves → broaden toward GNRC and premium grid/power, still subject to valuation/earnings.
regimeRules.narrowResilience: 10Y 5.0–5.25% + semis lead → prioritise current cash generation and funded backlog; stage entries.
regimeRules.disorderlyRepricing: 10Y >5.25% + MOVE/credit widen → raise hurdle; financing-heavy/premium/distant-cash-flow names move toward WAIT/WATCH.
regimeRules.growthCreditScare: 10Y falls + breadth/credit deteriorate → do not read lower yields mechanically as bullish; prefer balance-sheet resilience.
